Text: Agent Cost Attribution Framework

Without clear cost attribution, teams cannot decide which agents or features are actually worth running. Total spend numbers alone are not enough.

As a dev, I now attribute every token and tool call back to the owning agent, tenant, and feature.

Cost Attribution Cheatsheet:
1. Tag every request with agent, tenant, and feature IDs
2. Capture token and tool costs at the call level
3. Aggregate costs daily by dimension
4. Set budgets and alerts per agent or tenant
5. Review cost vs business value regularly
6. Make cost data visible to the owning teams

Core principle: You cannot optimize what you cannot attribute.

Pro tip: Start attribution at the orchestration layer — it is the cleanest place to inject tags.

How do you currently attribute agent costs in your systems?
